item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Reads the first system message from `lm.history[0]` and asserts it contains `lookup` and `next_tool_name`, matching the ReAct planning prompt with tool catalog and planning outputs."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Reads the second system message from `lm.history[1]` and asserts it omits `lookup` and `next_tool_name` while containing the base task instruction, matching the separate fallback extraction prompt."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM` so the first call selects `finish` immediately and the second call returns the answer, producing one planning call followed by one extraction call."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Prints both system prompts and checks the first for planning markers and the second for absence of tool catalog/planning fields plus presence of the original task-only instruction."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
